key_terms.الْأَحْوَلُ: Al-Aḥwal, a kunya or epithet of the narrator
key_terms.صَالِحُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ: Ṣāliḥ ibn Saʿīd, a specific narrator
key_terms.ضَعِيفٌ: Weak, a technical term in hadith sciences indicating a narrator's reliability is not strong

ai.seo_question: Who is Ṣāliḥ ibn Saʿīd al-Aḥwal and what is his status as a narrator?
ai.summary: This is a brief biographical entry from the book *Kitab al- Duafa* (The Book of Weak Narrators). It identifies the narrator Ṣāliḥ ibn Saʿīd, known as al-Aḥwal, and classifies him as 'weak' (daʿīf) in terms of his reliability in transmitting hadith.
